task: Dear ranger <Ranger>, the government of <FromPlanet> has authorised me to make you an offer. An annual, open, super-high-speed foncer race championship will soon be held on a planet in the <ToStar> star system. Our planet won the honour of taking part in the final race, but, unfortunately, pirates shot down the spaceship that was taking our racer to <ToPlanet> and so far we have no information about him. You are our last hope! We all know that you are one of our best pilots, so you will be able to manage a foncer too. You must arrive on <ToPlanet> by <Date>, or they will declare us losers. If you win the race, you will get a substantial material award in the amount of <Money> cr. Our resident representative will be waiting for you on planet <ToPlanet>. He will provide you with the details. Will you help us?
success: On behalf of <FromPlanet> I express our deepest gratitude to you for your help and hand you the award in the amount of <Money> cr! Your triumphant victory in the foncer races proved that a space ranger is capable of everything. Dominators won't succumb!!!
loc.1.0:
There are mechanics waiting in the boxes already. One of them must be the chief, he welcomes you and then recites a speech he obviously has memorized:

- We have four basic foncer models to offer you.

<clr>"Hurricane"<clrEnd> is the fastest foncer with excellent manoeuvrability. Its protection is minimal. 
<clr>"Tornado"<clrEnd> is the foncer with the highest manoeuvrability and possesses wonderful speed qualities. Its protection is minimal.
<clr>"Vortex"<clrEnd> is the best protected foncer but its manoeuvrability and speed leave much to be desired. 
<clr>"Breeze"<clrEnd> is the most prevailing foncer model. All its parameters are average.

Also you have the possibility to configure your <clr>personal model <clrEnd>.

loc.19.0:
You landed softly and left your spaceship quickly. Nearby you saw a huge holographic screen with changing shots of small machine races and welcoming words to all championship participants in all languages of the Galaxy. 

You had hardly admired the nice pictures, some of which were rather alarming, by the way (small explosions with fragments flying in different directions, for example), when you noticed the Welcomer. He approached you and said:

- Hello, <Ranger>! I'm the <FromPlanet>'s representative. I'm happy that you've come just in time, the race will start soon, and we should participate in the draw and then go the boxes to choose a foncer for you. Though, if you have any questions, I'll be glad to answer them. I'm Slyboots. I guess you realise that this is not my name, but a nickname. However, I'm used to it, so please call me by my nickname.
loc.19.1: - The track is divided into <clr>11 segments<clrEnd> of different complexity and length. You can pass each section using different tactics. Pay special attention to the segment length, your elapsed race time and other factors that can affect it. Your race time will change more on a longer segment than a shorter one. Each racer will be driving along their own track line, so there's no chance of any collisions with one another. Concentrating on avoiding obstacles is all that is necessary. To prevent disputes between racers, both lines are completely identical to each other.
loc.19.2: - Actually, a foncer is a small mountable vehicle with a powerful engine. Apart from the engine itself, it also has a forcefield generator, a feeble anti-gravity turbine and manoeuvring controls. The anti-gravity turbine gives enough power for the pilot to hover 3-5 meters above ground, so actually the pilots are competing in air-racing, not just motor-racing. Due to a lack of friction, the speed during the race can become as high as 1000 km/h. In the event that the pilot's reflexes aren't quick enough to evade all the obstacles while driving the foncer, <clr>the forcefield generator <clrEnd> is used. Any collision causes damage to the field. It is impossible to completely avoid collisions, even on the simplest track segments. If the cursor of the protection meter falls to zero, the foncer will simply destruct, along with the racer. So, if you are not sure of yourself, you ought to fall back.
loc.19.3:
- The final part of the tournament consists of three stages. Namely: 

<clr>First stage<clrEnd> - Qualification race. At this stage you may compete with an inexperienced racer.
<clr>Second stage<clrEnd> - Semi-final race. No more inexperienced competitors here. The winner will take part in the final race.
<clr>Third stage<clrEnd> - The final race. Its winner becomes the champion for the next four years. Your competitor will be very strong, and may be the champion himself.
By the way, now it is Mikhael Shulman.

To win you must <clr>be the first to finish all three races<clrEnd>.
loc.23.0:
You are in the machine shop; the chief mechanic needs the directions on power distribution and is giving necessary explanations:

- The main generator's power can be divided into <clr>9<clrEnd> flows, and each flow can supply <clr>the engine<clrEnd>, <clr>the forcefield generator <clrEnd> or <clr>the manoeuvring controls<clrEnd>. No more than <clr>5<clrEnd> flows can supply each item.

- Excellent! We were right trusting in you. If you want to stay in the current foncer model, it won't take long for our mechanics to get it ready for the next race. Or do you prefer to change the model? Then next race will start in an hour.
loc.33.0:
The decor of the hall where the draw was to be held was imposing. A huge exposition was placed along the perimeter and around the seats. Old-fashioned models of foncers and past champions' hologram portraits were exhibited there along with wreckages and holograms in penitential framing. They reminded you how dangerous the sport was.

All the seats in the hall were occupied by the racers, their representatives and guests of honour. At first the colourful opening ceremony was held, after which they made speeches quite uninteresting for you, and then finally, the sponsors started the draw.

You managed to pick out the following important information from what you heard. All together there are <clr>6<clrEnd> best sportsmen who have reached this final part of the tournament. Four of them are to race in the first stage, known traditionally as the Qualifiers. Two winners will then compete with the previously defined leaders in the Semi-final race, which is the second stage. Consequently, the Semi-final winners will take part in the Final race, which will define the champion.

The arbiter calls you out to the stage together with the other three racers who will participate in the Qualifiers. They are Peleng Rasgush, Maloq Gonzar, and Faeyan Miatra.
loc.33.1:
Peleng Rasgush answers your greeting and those sitting in the hall are applauding to this display of his respect.
In all appearances, this racer prefers <clr>speed and manoeuvrability <clrEnd> and loves <clr>taking risks<clrEnd> like all Pelengs.

You are standing on the stage together with the other three racers, and there is a basket with the pin palling lots in it.
loc.33.2:
Maloq Gonsar is roaring some dark things and a slight murmur runs through the ranks. The thing is that all the sportsmen respect competitions and their atmosphere. Legends say that some planets used to have the traditions of intermitting wars during sports festivals. So now they don't approve of Gonzar's behaviour.
"This Maloq hardly pays much attention to his forcer's speed or manoeuvrability", - you thought. - But he surely has the maximum <clr>protection<clrEnd>!"

You are standing on the stage together with the other three racers, and there is a basket with the pin palling lots in it.
loc.33.3:
Faeyan Miatra answered your greetings with delicate kindness but his words were so grandiloquent, that there were only a few individuals in the hall who were able to enjoy all the style. Moreover, some attendants could hear veiled irony in his answer. Either way, an awkward silence settled in the hall for a short period of time.
Perhaps, this cunning Faeyan will consider <clr>manoeuvrability<clrEnd> to be the keystone of his victory in the race.

You are standing on the stage together with the other three racers, and there is a basket with the pin palling lots in it.

It will be one of two Earthen: either: <clr>Vladimir Korchenitza <clrEnd>, who is equally fast and manoeuvrable, or the current champion, <clr>Mikhael Shulman <clrEnd>, famous for his unusual <clr>speed<clrEnd>.
